setup_description: Keep codex-speed running, then start Codex in another terminal with this command.
copy_manual: Command selected. Press Ctrl+C (⌘C on macOS) to copy.
setup_step1: Start the monitor before Codex. Restart Codex if it is already running.
setup_step2: Use Codex as usual. The dashboard updates when native metrics arrive.
setup_step3: TTFT and TBT appear when server timings arrive; token usage updates after the turn ends.
setup_note: Settings apply to this launch only. Server timings require provider support; missing values appear as —.
details_description: Uses native server timings, without turn duration or client network timing.
ttft_definition: Server-reported Service TTFT. The headline value is the observation mean over the selected window.
decode_definition: 1000 ÷ mean Service TBT (ms). This is an estimate from server TBT, not a per-token measurement.
token_definition: Reported totals from native turn.token_usage. Input includes cached input; output includes reasoning output. Do not add these subsets to their totals. Reasoning tokens are used for internal reasoning, not visible answer length. Fields are counted independently; missing values are not zero.
cache_definition: Total cached input ÷ total input. Unavailable when fields are missing, report counts differ, or input is zero.
reliability_definition: Failed attempts ÷ all attempts. HTTP requests and WebSocket sends are counted separately, including retries. These measure request and send results, not generation or task success. Missing attempt counts appear as —.
quantiles_definition: Estimated from histograms; single-observation batches allow exact values. P95 requires at least 20 observations. Export batches are not requests or turns.
details_caption: Server timings for the selected window
hero_description: Monitor first-token latency, generation speed, and token usage.
connection_error: Unable to connect to the monitor
ttft_hint: Server-reported Service TTFT, excluding client network latency. The headline is the window mean. P50 is the median; P95 is the 95th percentile and requires 20 observations. Estimated quantiles are marked ≈.
decode_window: Selected window · from mean Service TBT
decode_hint: 1000 ÷ mean Service TBT (ms), using server timings over the selected window. Not a per-token measurement.
decode_context: Generation speed after the first token
tokens_hint: The headline is total reported output tokens. Input includes cached input; output includes reasoning output. Do not add subsets to their totals. Cached input share is total cached input ÷ total input, not a request cache hit rate; it is unavailable when report counts differ. Missing fields appear as —, not zero.
timing_trend_description: TTFT points are bucket means; decode is estimated from each bucket's mean TBT. Lines show trends only.
token_trend_description: Input includes cached input; output includes reasoning output. Points are bucket totals. Select a legend item to view one series.
reliability_description: Summaries cover the selected window; points show bucket failure rates. Retries count separately. These are not task failure rates.
footer_note: Local collection · 7-day retention · native server metrics
waiting_attempts: Waiting for native request and send counts
fetch_error: Unable to fetch metrics. Check that codex-speed is running.
page_description: Local live monitoring of Codex model service performance.
recent_timings_description: Latest first-token latency and generation speed.
recent_tokens_description: Latest input and output usage · tokens.
waiting_ttft_reports: No timing reports in this window yet.
waiting_token_reports: No token reports in this window yet.
reports_note: Filtered by receipt time, up to 20 batches per list. A batch may contain multiple requests; each metric has its own observation count.
report_cache_definition: Batch cached input total ÷ input total; unavailable with missing fields, different observation counts, or zero input.
